description:
Find Brassica genebank accessions by accession number or name: Brassica, Camelina, Sinapis and Raphanus
accessions from GBIF, with the holding genebank (FAO WIEWS code) and accession number; mostly Svalbard Global
Seed Vault safety duplicates. Passport data are minimal (no traits); request seed from the holding genebank.
Also INRAE GnpIS Brassica collections via FAIDARE (B. napus, B. oleracea and B. rapa)
with taxon, holding institute, country of origin, status, pedigree and panels.
name: find_germplasm
